## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -15.28%) ↓ falling (BELOW TREND) and Sector Breadth weak (Energy and Tech only) support a neutral, narrow market.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -15.28%) ↓ falling (BELOW TREND). Credit neutral: HYG (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -0.01%) → flat (BELOW TREND); Stocks vs Bonds neutral: SPY_TLT → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -0.67%) ↓ falling (BELOW TREND) and LQD (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -0.91%) → flat (BELOW TREND) point to modestly tighter financial conditions without clear dislocation.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ↑ rising (ABOVE TREND). Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY. Financials weak: XLF (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -1.15%) → flat (BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally weak: SPY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.80%) → flat (BELOW TREND). EM CORRECTION: EEM (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION. China soft: FXI (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -2.12%) → flat (BELOW TREND).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Cryptos/innovation up on 1M but soft on 1W: IBIT (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +20.34%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -2.79% | 1M: +8.64%) CORRECTION; small caps weak: IWM (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -2.55%) ↓ falling (BELOW TREND).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity strength: BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ↑ rising (ABOVE TREND), USO (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +21.91%) ↑ rising (ABOVE TREND). Precious metals correcting: GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy and gas strong: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ↑ rising (ABOVE TREND) and UNG (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +10.03%) ↑ rising (ABOVE TREND).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership via XLE ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Multiple 1W/1M mismatches in GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION, IBIT (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +20.34%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -2.79% | 1M: +8.64%) CORRECTION — MINOR divergence but widespread across riskier ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy/commodity ETFs showing strength (XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to industrials and cyclical ETFs under pressure (XLI (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -7.31%) BELOW TREND, ITA (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -10.88%) BELOW TREND); monitor GLD and IBIT for reversal risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: XLI (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; XRT (1W: -2.10% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +21.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -1.52%) ↓ falling (BELOW TREND) and GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) — VXX (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -15.28%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -0.01%) → flat (BELOW TREND) / LQD (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -0.91%) → flat (BELOW TREND). XLK/XLF pivot ~2.0 to signal growth vs value rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Energy and commodities showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +4.28% | 1M: +11.24%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.29% | 1M: +22.99%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: narrow advance with multiple 1W/1M corrections in GLD (1W: -4.40% | 1M: +7.65%) CORRECTION and crypto/innovation ETFs (IBIT (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +20.34%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -2.79% | 1M: +8.64%) CORRECTION) — monitor for reversal.
